meaning:
λιβανωτός, -οῦ, ὁ
(λίβανος), [in LXX: 1Ch.9:29, 3Ma.5:2 * ;]
1. in cl. (and LXX), frankincense, the gum of the libanus.
2. = Late Gk., λιβανωτρίς, a censer: Rev.8:3, 5 (the same form appears in Inscr.; MM, xvi).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on…
